title: Tariff & Trade Deadline Tracker
description: Upcoming and recent U.S. tariff effective dates, expirations and phase-ins that change landed cost.
intro: Every date here changes what you pay for imported goods. We update this tracker with each newsroom run. Always confirm details with your customs broker and the official notice.
